parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the top movable part of the dispenser, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It is pressed by the user to pump liquid from the container through the nozzle.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns upward via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head connects the pressing lid to the internal pump mechanism and nozzle.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the pump chamber to the outlet spout.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but transfers motion from the pressing lid to the pump mechanism.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: The outlier is the nozzle or spout part of the dispenser, made of lightweight plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the liquid outward in a controlled stream when the pump is pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed relative to the head but allows liquid flow through its channel.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, typically transparent or opaque plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid (soap, lotion, sanitizer, etc.) to be dispensed.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the structural support for the entire dispenser.
